description: United States: can I retire at 62 with $800k?

claimAge.description: Age you start Social Security, 62 to 70 (default 67)

dbPension.description: Defined benefit pension a year, USD (0 if none)

drawAge.description: Age 401(k)/IRA withdrawals start, 60 or later (default the retirement age)

growth.description: Pension growth % a year after charges (an assumption)

partnerSalary.description: Partner gross pay a year, USD

partnerSocialSecurityMonthly.description: Partner Social Security at 67, USD a month

savings.description: Savings and investments outside pensions, USD

savingsAdd.description: Added to savings each year until retirement, USD

socialSecurityMonthly.description: Social Security at full retirement age (67), USD a month, from the my Social Security statement

spending.description: Household spending a year in retirement after tax, today’s money, USD

stateRate.description: Flat state income tax rate, % of income other than Social Security (default 0)

ukPensionWeekly.description: UK State Pension forecast a week in pounds (uprated in the US; 0 if none)

name: us_can_i_retire
